items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...what's the difference between, say, Alucha and Jerry Wexler? [INTERVIEWEE] A hundred percent. It's just like going from north, turning around and going south.

ctx.x: He didn't tell me nothing. He gave me to give me some old address. He's talking about I can write to somebody in France. Let you do that for me. That's right. Yeah.

Let's get back to Atlantic. Okay. And there's something that you're coming from Imperial. Okay. Well, after, after. Between what I'm saying, what's the difference between, say, Alucha and Jerry Wexler?
